candidates.name: White Cable Turtleneck
candidates.decisionReason: The product-only cable knit has a narrow shaped torso, tall bulky ribbed neck and no worn drape proof; it reads Winter and would bunch under a blazer.

candidates.name: Beige Fine-Knit Turtleneck
candidates.decisionReason: The isolated slim product render provides no shoulder, chest, sleeve or hem evidence and the washed beige tone lacks intentional Fall evening color.

candidates.name: Beige Quarter-Zip Knit
candidates.decisionReason: Contrast orange zips, a chest pocket and athletic quarter-zip construction make this sporty rather than Formal Evening.

candidates.name: Off-White Geometric Rib Sweater
candidates.decisionReason: The strongly dropped shoulder, thick geometric rib and oversized bulky body cannot sit cleanly beneath tailored outerwear.

candidates.name: Ivory Striped Crew Sweater
candidates.decisionReason: Burgundy horizontal stripes, a chest badge and casual crew shape read generic weekend knit rather than refined evening base.

candidates.name: White Short-Sleeve Mock-Neck Knit
candidates.decisionReason: The generic product-only tee gives no worn fit or material proof and looks flat and basic for a Fall Formal outfit.

candidates.name: White Twin-Pocket Button-Up
candidates.decisionReason: The translucent overshirt, twin chest pockets and visible label are Casual utility details rather than Formal shirting.

candidates.name: White Open-Placket Textured Shirt
candidates.decisionReason: The modern open placket is useful, but the lightweight texture and relaxed construction are explicitly Spring/Summer Casual and lack Fall substance.

candidates.name: Warm-Coffee Textured Button-Up
candidates.decisionReason: The jacquard texture is interesting, but the dropped shoulder, long broad overshirt body, patch pocket, visible base tee and backpack styling remain Casual.

candidates.name: Light-Khaki Textured Henley Knit
candidates.decisionReason: The clean henley neckline is directionally useful, but only a shaped product form is shown; worn shoulder, torso, sleeve and hem behavior are unproven.

candidates.name: Dusty-Blue Corduroy Shirt
candidates.decisionReason: The dusty blue is welcome, but it is shown only as a long open corduroy overshirt over a tee with cap styling, not as a refined evening top.

candidates.name: Gray Fine-Stripe Button-Down
candidates.decisionReason: The fine stripe is restrained, but the long open-over-tee body, dropped shoulder and jeans styling make it a Casual overshirt with a flat gray palette.

candidates.name: Coffee Contrast-Stitch Overshirt
candidates.decisionReason: The camel-coffee color is useful, but two large workwear patch pockets, contrast stitching and a long open body are not Formal construction.

candidates.name: Moss Twin-Pocket Cotton Overshirt
candidates.decisionReason: The muted moss supports the palette, but the long boxy body, dropped shoulder and twin flap pockets create utility Casual volume.

candidates.name: Muted-Blue Twin-Pocket Cotton Overshirt
candidates.decisionReason: The blue lifts the palette, but the same long dropped utility construction and two prominent flap pockets lack evening refinement.

candidates.name: Creamy-White Corduroy Overshirt
candidates.decisionReason: The creamy corduroy is attractive, but the very broad long body, dropped shoulder and oversized twin pockets create heavy utility volume.

candidates.name: Army-Green Corduroy Wide-Leg Trouser
candidates.decisionReason: The product-only corduroy image cannot prove rise or drape and shows a balloon-taper leg, rolled cuffs and D-ring detail rather than precise Formal tailoring.

candidates.name: Camel Wide-Leg Casual Trouser
candidates.decisionReason: The low casual rise, broad cotton leg and heavy fold over a chunky sneaker recreate the baggy everyday silhouette being removed.

candidates.name: Gray Drawstring Straight Trouser
candidates.decisionReason: The gathered waistband, oversized exposed drawcord, black D-ring and synthetic sheen are lounge or technical details, not Formal tailoring.

candidates.name: Light-Gray Relaxed Trouser
candidates.decisionReason: The isolated crop hides rise, seat, full length and shoe break, while diagonal knee seams and smooth technical cloth prevent a Formal approval.

candidates.name: Light-Khaki Relaxed Blazer
candidates.decisionReason: The blazer is extremely long and boxy with overlong sleeves, low patch pockets and thin flat cloth, creating uncontrolled upper volume rather than Mid-Range evening tailoring.
